integrity: The proof uses invariant spectral blocks and exact two-line lower bounds; finite rational tests support but do not replace universal arguments. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: Only symmetric stochastic chains with uniform target, complete bipartite support, a fixed distinguished perfect matching, and a common bound or fixed probability on matching transitions. This does not classify all nonsymmetric optimal designs; the SLEM objective does not optimize every finite-time distance. Publication priority is not independently confirmed.
title: Sharp matching-channel capacity law for fastest mixing on \(K_{m,m}\)
